lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You're here.
Ingrid.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I came to check on the Wings of Victory.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: While I was here, I figured I'd check in on the Goddess Squad too.
How's the ship?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Well... it'll be easier to repair it than to build a new one from scratch, but not by much.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: At least it wasn't blown completely to pieces.
Is Over the Horizon safe?
Ingrid points silently.
Over the Horizon is looking at the Wings of Victory while having a serious conversation.
Several mechanics from Elysion are with them.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We're planning to upgrade it as we repair it.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Now that it's made it through the most extreme of military operations, we should have a much better idea of the upgrades it needs.
How long will it take?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm not sure yet. The first step is moving it to the Ark.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's a miracle that it only got damaged as much as it did in a standoff against the Queen.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There's something I still don't understand.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: In the battle with the Queen, we didn't see any Storm Bringers, or any other Tyrant-Class Raptures.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If those things had gotten involved, I believe the outcome would've been very different.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do you know anything about that?
Gluttony didn't get involved either.
It's weird. I'd heard it tried to eat the girl... I mean, the Queen that the Four Beasts made,
yet it was nowhere to be seen when there were two Queens in battle.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Exactly. It's suspicious.
Agreed. As to the reason, though, I have no idea.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: No? I see.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Well, a careful investigation will bring something to light.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If you're looking for the Goddess Squad, they're getting treated over there.
... How are they?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Not great. Not bad either.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We wanted to move them to the Ark, but they completely refused.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: So they're being treated in a camp.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Naturally, Elysion has the absolute best methods for treating people in camps. They are as tactical as can be.
Sounds very... tactical.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Exactly. Tactical.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: As much as I'd love to discuss the tactics used in this battle with you, I don't want to keep you too long.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Go. Goddess is waiting.
Okay. See you around.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Bye now.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do you know where we're standing right now?
Huh...? Uh, on the surface...?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Yeah. On the surface.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The long-feared surface.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: And here we are, having a peaceful conversation.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: This is all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You did well, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Thank you. I mean it.
Thank you.
I walk.
The Goddess Squad comes into view.
Hey, everyone.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Your Grace. You came.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Hey. Have you eaten?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: How now, my Lord.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hi, Believer.
I find an empty seat.
I look around at each of them.
... It's over.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Yeah. It's over.
What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Our purpose is clear.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Fortunately, we have some time, so I'd like to rest a little.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: But I don't really know how.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Just eat and sleep a ton. You'll figure it out.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Forget not the ale. Let us drink together.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'll probably read some books I've been putting off.
How are Noah and Papillon?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: They went to Eden with the Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: They said they didn't want to owe the Ark anything.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: An oath harmful to none but themselves. To merit treatment, their deeds in battle do already suffice.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hehe, maybe they were just feeling shy.
That's too bad. I wanted to thank them.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Methinks thou shalt not want for opportunity to thank them hereafter.
Scarlet looks around the expanse of the surface.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: For we may now come and go as freely as the wind.
... Right.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It looks like you have a question.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Is it about our Commander and Lilith?
Yeah. I wasn't sure if it'd be okay to ask.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: For you, it's okay.
Don't you feel sad that it just suddenly kinda... happened?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It was sudden, for sure.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It was a really sudden goodbye.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Right after Lilith became herself again,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dark Matter swallowed her up.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: And when the Commander and Lilith came back out, I sensed it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The Queen hadn't given up on her.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: There was no other way.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That's why the Commander did what he did.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: He gave his life so Lilith could go out as herself.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: He chose to go out with her.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: And that's why we had to say goodbye so quickly.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I think they both knew that they didn't have much time left.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: They looked anxious.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: You could tell just by looking at their faces.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: That's why they had no other choice but to say a quick goodbye.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: When you don't have much time left, it's good to spend it with someone precious to you.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Still,

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: it's hard not to feel a bit of lingering disappointment.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I wish we could've talked more. You know, have a real conversation.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Yeah, but...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: it's okay.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We told her everything we needed to.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: At least I think so.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Yeah, you're right...
Are you not going to look for them?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: What a drab thing to say.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: We must allow them time to use as they may.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Though I have no memory of them, of that much I know.
You don't remember anything about them?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A feeling doth remain.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A sort of sweetly sorrowful longing.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: That is all. In truth, there is little difference 'twixt them and strangers.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Yet... I trust I shall hear tales of them without end, and ere long shall know them well.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That's right. You better be ready for it.
Dorothy, you said earlier that your purpose was clear.
Can I ask what that is?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The black moon and Marian.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We have to do something about them.
... Is there even something that can be done?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You can hear more from her.
Snow White points to Nayuta, who's standing on a hill watching the black moon.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: She's waiting for you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: She already told all of us.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Now that we've seen you, we should head back.
Head back? To where?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Eden.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We need to go back to Eden and get the rest of our equipment.
Why not stock up here? The Ark's technology is good.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: But...
Snow White looks around.
As she does, the many people who had been watching them hastily avoid her gaze.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... A lot of eyes are on us.
Well, yeah. You're the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I don't need it. Dorothy's the one starved for attention. Give it to her.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Yeah, let's go.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Scarcely had I sat, and already we go.
... Are you worried about going to Eden?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'd be lying if I said no.
Don't worry. You guys can talk everything out.
Be honest.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'll do my best.
The Goddesses gets up and start walking.
Everyone watches them as they leave.
Also.
Thank you.
They all turn back and nod.
Then they keep walking.
I turn to look at Nayuta.
She's silently gazing up at the black moon.
I go up the hill.
A metallic clanking rises from the ground.
Nayuta.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou art come, Great Hero.
Do you have some time?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ay. I did await thy coming.
Then tell me everything. I have a lot of questions.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The role of the Queen, the Seven Arbiters, the life of the planet...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: All these things are knit close together.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet I must begin with the Mechanical Messiah Project.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In times past, destruction threatened this world.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis a common tale. Unbridled development did make short the life of the planet.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: An enterprise was undergone for to set the matter aright. This was the Mechanical Messiah Project.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Devices were created to restore the planet: Raptures 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, and 07, called the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Created to govern them was a central control device. This was called the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The plan was simple. The Queen should manage the Seven Arbiters, and they should save the dying planet.
That's what you were talking about before, isn't it?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Yet as thou knowest, the Queen did go amiss.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen became a foe to humanity, and so to extinguish them created Raptures framed after the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Seven Arbiters were neglected, and humanity hid in the Ark.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Much time passed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen beyond the heavens descended not, and the Seven Arbiters, wanting for a Queen, did ceaselessly strive to create a new one...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... A Queen set on a course by someone's hand to destroy humanity.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Each new Queen was destroyed apace by the Gene Reaper, yet none could be certain a Queen able to subdue the Gene Reaper would never come forth.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And so... I...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I resolved to wholly prevent the creation of a new Queen.
... And you did that using me and Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... It is so. I am very sorry...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I did fail to foresee the Queen's descent, and the manner in which a new Queen would be created.
It's fine. Don't worry about that anymore.
Tell me more about the lifespan of the planet.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: By reason of the Queen's absence, the Seven Arbiters fell still.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The restoration of the planet stopped.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In its due course, the planet was fated to expire in no more than fifty years.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: However, its life did extend as humanity dwindled and sought refuge underground.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus do I believe it to have twenty years of life left, more or less.
And there's no way things will just return to how they were?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Nay.
I look up at the black moon.
Inside, Marian is all alone.
Then Marian must be working on restoring the planet in there.
She's trying to keep it alive.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Thou shouldst know, 'tis for thy sake.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should the planet fall to ruin, thou wouldst not survive.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: If I reflect on Young Lady Marian's intent,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: that of creating a world where all might love all,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: methinks the root of it lies in her desire to protect thy life from harm.
Do you think she'll come out of there once the planet has been restored?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Indeed. The need to control the Seven Arbiters will be no more.
How long will it take?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I know not, but I warrant an hundred some years.
... That's too long. I can't wait that long.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis long indeed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Moreover, a certain matter is still awry.
I'm guessing it's something related to the Seven Arbiters.
Nayuta nods.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Rememberest thou Gluttony?
Yeah, I do.
I was actually wondering about that too. Why did Gluttony not get involved in this most recent battle?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Twas wary of the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The original Queen descended, and the Maleficent Beast Quartet created a new Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Furthermore, Young Lady Marian herself did become a Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Three Queens, all alive in the same time.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I judge the Seven Arbiters' confusion was great.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Which of the three Queens was real? Whose orders must be obeyed?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Amid such tumult, the Queen stole Young Lady Marian's gene, and the Maleficent Beast Quartet's Queen yielded her gene to Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Seven Arbiters likely thought it a battle for the role of Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus did not even Gluttony join.
Hang on. Does that mean Gluttony is one of the Seven Arbiters?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yes.
... But Gluttony attacked when the Four Beasts made the child.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Gluttony acts in a manner all its own.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To be precise, each of the Seven Arbiters behaves in its own manner.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Gluttony sought to devour the Queen, but retreated when three Queens came forth.
That means there's a chance it will make a move again now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Consider that Caliginous Material. 'Tis of a density even Gluttony would not covet.
So there's an issue with the Seven Arbiters...
and they're all behaving in their own different ways, including Gluttony...
In other words, there's a high probability that they're all broken in some way right now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ay, thou hast hit it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So soon as the Mechanical Messiah Project was abandoned, humans did employ the Seven Arbiters according to their own wills.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They had no cause to abstain from using such tremendous power.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They used it to excess with little thought,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and in so doing, caused the Seven Arbiters to fall out of joint.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They retain the ability to perform their office; however, their intentions have become vastly twisted.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Gluttony's charge was once to consume all waste and restore it,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: but behold Gluttony now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis a monstrosity that seeks to devour any large energy source.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though the Seven Arbiters still are under the principal command to restore the planet with the Queen,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: at present they are naught but monsters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Mayhap even the Queen did pause to descend for fear of them.
Then what's Marian doing inside that black moon right now?
You said she had to work with the Arbiters to restore the planet.
If they're all messed up, is that even possible?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis not impossible.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It will simply be a long work, likely to last a hundred and some years.
In that case...
If the Seven Arbiters go back to normal,
how long will it take for them to finish restoring the planet?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: There is no knowing, yet it would be but a fraction of the time. Of that I am certain.
What do we have to do to get them back to normal?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: First, find them.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Then we must restore them by any means.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: With my best endeavor I shall search for where they are, and a means to restore them.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou must rest with those who give thee strength and maintain thine utmost state.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: When the time comes, I shall find thee.
Okay.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Then our journey hereforth is decided.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: After restoring the Seven Arbiters, we shall remove Young Lady Marian from the black moon.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Will that suffice?
I lift my head and look up.
The black moon looks lonely floating all alone.
Yeah.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... In truth, I find it a great relief that Young Lady Marian became the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Her kind heart bringeth hope to this planet.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I judge thou and the maidens by thy side did help make her so.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I give thee my thanks.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And I am sorry.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall expend all my might until my sinews crack to remove Young Lady Marian from that place.
Thank you.
To be honest, it doesn't feel real
that the Earth has only twenty years left, or that the Seven Arbiters exist.
But Marian is alone up there, and if that's the only way to bring her down,
then I have no choice but to act.
Does the Ark know about this? About the arbiters and the Earth's lifespan?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Enikk knoweth.
Then why haven't they done anything?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To speak of a problem with no solution inviteth naught but confusion,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and while Raptures ruled the surface, little could be done.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And also, the building of the Ark had many purposes,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: of which one is to shelter people from calamity.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should the surface come to ruin, the Ark will survive.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It will not endure long, but live it shall.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: However, the situation has changed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen is on our side, and the Raptures no longer rule the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I believe Young Lady Enikk will begin to act now also.
So the Third Surface Reclamation War was needed for a bunch of reasons.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The result of the war did frame our circumstances well, and all is now prepared.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should we fix the Seven Arbiters...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: then all will be as it should.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The surface will fill out once again.
What exactly are the Seven Arbiters, anyway? How are they able to restore the planet?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They are great machines with the technology to restore the dying planet.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 01.
A device to accelerate evolutionary adaptation. Pride.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 02.
A device to recycle waste. Gluttony.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 03.
An advanced biomimicry device. Envy.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 04.
A device that responds to planetary threats. Wrath.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 05.
A device to find and gather resources. Greed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 06.
A device that preserves life through stasis. Sloth.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text:
Rapture 07.
A device that promotes the creation of new life. Lust.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: All of them far outstrip the bounds of common sense and standard thinking.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... The journey ahead shall be onerous.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: We know not the circumstance in which we will encounter them.
It's okay.
We have the Goddesses of Victory.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Well said.
